content:
China's Apple Watch users can join a National Fitness Day challenge this weekend to unlock virtual rewards.

According to the upcoming fitness challenge prompt, completing the Apple Watch challenge requires finishing a 20-minute workout session on Saturday, August 8.

The event is exclusive to China, as August 8 is National Fitness Day each year.

After completing the challenge, four animated stickers can be unlocked on iOS, as well as a virtual medal in the Fitness app.

Apple regularly hosts activity challenges around the world to encourage Apple Watch users to experience different types of exercise.

The latest Apple Watch Series 11 is now on sale, starting at US$299.
